newsitem.title: LATVIA: Trade in Daugavpils dominates quiet Latvian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Daugavpils dominates quiet Latvian bourse.

text.p: Market leader Unibanka's share price remained unchanged amid a relatively quiet trading session at Latvia's bourse on Thursday, dealers said.
Overall market volume was almost 59,000 lats and Unibanka's price remained at 2.05 lats.
Shares in Daugavpils PR, a chain belt factory, accounted for most of the day's turn-over at almost 35,000 lats and its price rose by 6.25 percent to 0.85 lats.
